{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Check: are there any 'refunded' orders among loyal customers?
refunded_loyal = loyal_df[loyal_df['status'] == 'refunded']

# Count them
n_refunded_loyal = len(refunded_loyal)

# Confirm: converted=1 only if status='completed' and converted=1
# Check if any refunded order has converted=1
refunded_converted = refunded_loyal[refunded_loyal['converted'] == 1]
n_refunded_converted = len(refunded_converted)

# Print results
print(f'Refunded orders among loyal customers: {n_refunded_loyal}')
print(f'Of those, how many have converted=1? {n_refunded_converted}')"}
